cards.card_text: Tertullus brings up the sect of the Nazarenes.
cards.verse_text: He is a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes,
cards.snippet: He is a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes,

cards.card_text: The Way, which his accusers call a sect.
cards.verse_text: I do confess to you, however, that I worship the God of our fathers according to the Way, which they call a sect.
cards.snippet: …God of our fathers according to the Way, which they call a sect.

cards.card_text: He lived as a ___, in the strictest sect of their religion.
cards.verse_text: They have known me for a long time and can testify, if they are willing, that I lived as a Pharisee, adhering to the strictest sect of our religion.
cards.snippet: …are willing, that I lived as a Pharisee, adhering to the strictest sect of our religion.

cards.card_text: The Jewish leaders tell Paul that the sect he's part of, the followers of Jesus, is welcomed by people everywhere.
cards.verse_text: But we consider your views worth hearing, because we know that people everywhere are speaking against this sect.”
cards.snippet: …worth hearing, because we know that people everywhere are speaking against this sect.”
